name: load-agent-loop
description: Load scenario agent-loop (ticket 19.1): a bounded writer⇄critic refinement loop (ADR-016). The critic always returns {"verdict":"revise"} (scripted in the load mock), so every run does exactly max_iterations (3) loop-backs, each unrolled through store.ExpandRun and each auto-appending to the run thread (14.2), then exits via on_exhausted=proceed. Deterministic per-run work independent of the mock's per-process cursor, exercising loop unrolling + thread growth + expansion under load. Model `mock/load-std`.

writer.system: You are a writer. Draft or revise for the brief, addressing any critique notes.

critic.system: You are a load-test critic. Always request a revision.

Write for this brief, addressing critique notes.
